text:
lee_ae: Quick heads up 10yr audit retention + BYOK/HSM ask from Meridian Bank POC. They want line items for: base dedicated, audit log tiered pricing for 10 years, HSM-managed vs KMS-attested BYOK, and whether we can include SOC2/HIPAA artifacts in the commitment. Need something to send tomorrow.

maria_se: Copy. I'll draft a simple table. Can we confirm our standard cold/archive pricing and any minimums for WORM storage? Also need lead times for private deployment vs hosted with HSM.

josh_finance: Pricing guardrails: 12mo committed infra discount = 15% standard; 24mo = 20% standard. For large commits (> $400k ARR) we can escalate to 25% with deal-desk signoff. Audit log retention: public list roughly $0.10/GB/mo first year, sliding to $0.025/GB/mo long tail when archived. For guaranteed 10yr immutable retention (WORM + retrieval SLA) we add a lifecycle management fee and an archival minimum (we usually set $1,500/mo floor for managed long-term retention for enterprise POCs). HSM options: managed HSM pool (dedicated) = $9,000/mo, KMS with HSM attestation (shared infra) = $0.018/GB for key operations heavy workloads.

tara_legal: We can provide BAA and SOC2 Type II package. If they want packaged artifacts (signed manifests, rotation logs, evidence PDFs) we recommend PS to prepare an "audit bundle" — estimate 40 engineer-hours at $250/hr unless they want a cheaper standard bundle. I'll draft the clause that pins which artifacts are delivered and any redaction rules.

sam_security: Technical notes: BYOK integration timeline ~2-4 weeks for hosted attestation flow, 4-6 weeks for dedicated HSM onboarding (depends on vendor procurement). For 10yr retention we require WORM and integrity manifests (SHA256) stored with signed timestamps. Retrieval testing and export procedures need to be part of acceptance tests. If they require KMS/HSM rotation evidence every quarter, that's an ops uplift.

lee_ae: Do we have a starter quote I can share with procurement with "subject to deal-desk approval" language? They want line items to slot into their procurement doc.

maria_se: Draft quote snippet (sendable):

```
Base Dedicated (3 x medium GPU): $16,500/mo
12mo Commit (15%): -$2,475 => $14,025/mo
Audit Log Retention (10yr, tiered):
  Year 1: $0.10/GB/mo
  Year 2-3: $0.05/GB/mo
  Year 4-10: $0.025/GB/mo
Long-term retention management fee (enterprise floor): $1,500/mo
HSM managed pool (dedicated): $9,000/mo
KMS + HSM attestation (shared): $0.018/GB for heavy KMS ops
Compliance audit bundle (SOC2 evidence + HIPAA BAA + packaged artifacts): one-time PS $10,000 or $2,000/mo for 6mo support
Notes: Final pricing contingent on commit size; discounts >20% require deal-desk approval.
```

josh_finance: If they commit to $600k ACV we can compress audit pricing to $0.03/GB/mo and reduce the HSM managed pool to $6k/mo. Also willing to trade a one-time PS credit for an extended commit. I'll flag any concession requests to deal-desk.

lee_ae: I'll send this as an initial commercial summary and schedule a technical deep dive Thurs 9am. @maria_se please own the runbook + integration slide. @tara_legal can you preload a BAA draft?

maria_se: On it. Runbook will include: BYOK flow, retention lifecycle, export/restore SLA, POC acceptance criteria. Timeline: hosted+attested KMS = ~3 weeks, private dedicated + HSM = ~6-8 weeks.

tara_legal: Dropping the BAA + SOC2 checklist here by EOD. Will mark requirements that cause additional PS.

sam_security: I'll post a short integrity checklist for the POC (hashing, signed manifests, rotation evidence) and outline what we can automate vs manual.

deal-desk-bot: deal-desk-bot: created DEAL-1409 for Meridian Bank pricing review. Please attach commercial sheet for approval.

lee_ae: Thanks team. I'll circulate and tag deal-desk when I send the formal quote. Will ask Meridian for their expected archive size so we can firm up GB pricing. :rocket:
